races.name: Betting.Bet Free Racing Tips Mares' 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BLUE TOPAZ sets the standard on her third at Sedgefield last month and remains low mileage. She can take the opener. Miss Denver looks the obvious danger.

  1. BLUE TOPAZ
  2. MISS DENVER
  3. ESTHER SPRING (FR)

races.name: Betting.Bet New Betting Sites Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
The step back up in trip clearly suited NO MORE BOLERO at Stratford last week and he finds himself on an unchanged mark here. He can follow up. Course winner Jackstell got back on the scoreboard last time and looks the likeliest danger.

  1. NO MORE BOLERO
  2. JACKSTELL (FR)
  3. BETTY'S TIARA

races.name: Betting.Bet Play Champion Tipster Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
I LOVE YOU SIVOLA is thrown-in on his French form and has joined a yard amongst the winners. He could be worth chancing. Athena's Dream and Carrhill look the principal dangers.

  1. I LOVE YOU SIVOLA (FR)
  2. ATHENA'S DREAM
  3. CARRHILL (IRE)

races.name: Betting.Bet Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Preference is for SON OF HYPNOS, who bolted up under an attacking ride at Newton Abbot in August and Ryan Chapman's 9-y-o did a bit too much too soon attempting to replicate those tactics back there last month. The quirky Donnie Azoff won on this card 12 months ago and he can provide most resistance, with Krak also considered having his first start over hurdles for Dan Skelton.

  1. SON OF HYPNOS (IRE)
  2. DONNIE AZOFF (IRE)
  3. KRAK (FR)

races.name: tigerbet.co.uk Download Our App Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
This looks open so it may be worth chancing LADY DAPPLE ROSE, who was left poorly placed on her Uttoxeter return 4 weeks ago and Ben Pauling's 5-y-o should benefit from this step back up in trip. Barafundle Bay shaped much better than previously when fourth at Warwick recently, so she may emerge as the main threat if able to build on that here. Last-time-out winner Miracles Do Happen completes the shortlist.

  1. LADY DAPPLE ROSE (IRE)
  2. BARAFUNDLE BAY
  3. MIRACLES DO HAPPEN

races.name: Hereford Halloween Family Raceday 26th October Open Maiden NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Probably a match between the fillies UNFLAPPABLE and Lucy Glitters, with Ben Clarke's charge narrowly preferred.

  1. UNFLAPPABLE
  2. LUCY GLITTERS
  3. BOMBUS PASCUORUM (IRE)

races.name: Gents Night Saturday 24th October Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LIMERICK LEADER hasn't looked back since joining Nick Scholfield and is fancied to defy a 4 lb rise and bag win number 4 for the yard here.

  1. LIMERICK LEADER (FR)
  2. AXEL BLEUE
  3. MUMFORD'S MAGIC (IRE)

races.name: Heb Group 'The Power Behind Everyday' Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Not much chasing form to go on here and JAMADA is taken to add to his bumper/hurdles victories and make a winning start in this sphere for the in-form Olly Murphy/Sean Bowen team. Lady Kara has chasing experience on her side and could emerge as the main danger if keeping the mistakes down.

  1. JAMADA (IRE)
  2. LADY KARA
  3. CHEESY ICON

races.name: Case IH Drive Performance Drive Puma Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
THELASTHIGHKING clearly hasn't been the easiest to train given his infrequent appearances but the form of his Kempton fourth back in the spring is solid and resuming from a break with his yard having typically made a good start this autumn, this could be the time to catch him (gone well fresh). Move With The Beat is fancied to come on for his Fontwell reappearance 10 days ago and is the danger.

  1. THELASTHIGHKING (IRE)
  2. MOVE WITH THE BEAT (IRE)
  3. JET SMART (IRE)

races.name: Case IH Dealer Network Top Class Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MELODYS ENCORE makes plenty of appeal on paper and has found a very winnable opening for her debut. There is a good chance she will be clued up enough to see off Masterius.

  1. MELODYS ENCORE (IRE)
  2. MASTERIUS (FR)
  3. MADETHEMPAY

races.name: Book The Bistro In Seasons Restaurant Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DELULU laid down solid foundations in a pair of Worcester bumpers (arguably should have won on debut) and she makes plenty of appeal now her attentions are switched to hurdling by her top stable. Fakenham winner L'Amandine shaped like a stayer herself in that sphere and is interesting, whilst Masked Mistress remains with potential returned to hurdles.

  1. DELULU
  2. L'AMANDINE (IRE)
  3. MASKED MISTRESS (FR)

races.name: Celebrate With Sponsorship At Southwell Racecourse Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
WINSTON'S OATH has upped his game since the visor went on, building on a good second when opening his account in clear-cut fashion back at Fontwell 10 days ago. He appeals as the type to go on improving for his excellent yard and can follow up under Sean Bowen. Dante's Inferno, who is feasibly treated on his penultimate Market Rasen second, and the consistent Ballylicky Bay are others to consider.

  1. WINSTON'S OATH (IRE)
  2. DANTE'S INFERNO
  3. BALLYLICKY BAY (IRE)

races.name: Golf And Gallop Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
LUMINARIES races off the same mark as when successful at Kelso 9 days ago and, with the return to 3m firmly in his favour, he looks to have been found an excellent opportunity to follow up. East Eagle may emerge as the lead danger, with handicap debutant Trigger The Light another to monitor now his stamina is tested further.

  1. LUMINARIES (IRE)
  2. EAST EAGLE (IRE)
  3. TRIGGER THE LIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Apprentice Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
A reproduction of the form SANDITON showed when runner-up over C&D last time could be good enough for a second C&D success of the campaign. Midnight's Dream and Cuban Fiesta may provide the main opposition.

  1. SANDITON (IRE)
  2. MIDNIGHT'S DREAM (IRE)
  3. CUBAN FIESTA

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Apprentice Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
ASPIRE TO GLORY retains handicapping scope based on peak form and is ideally drawn for a front runner so there are reasons to be hopeful that he can supplement his recent C&D success. Snooze Lane shaped well on his recent return from an absence and is second choice ahead of Ravenglass, who was behind the selection here last time.

  1. ASPIRE TO GLORY (IRE)
  2. SNOOZE LANE (IRE)
  3. RAVENGLASS (IRE)

races.name: Follow attheraces On Instagram Handicap
races.verdict:
ROYAL COUNTY GLORY is on a roll and might be able to defy a penalty and stretch his winning run on all-weather to 4. Cosmic Clarets made a positive start for the Scott Dixon yard when runner-up over 6f here last month and can fill the forecast spot ahead of his former stablemate Supreme Dancer.

  1. ROYAL COUNTY GLORY (IRE)
  2. COSMIC CLARETS (IRE)
  3. SUPREME DANCER (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks a good opportunity for BELLA ANGELINA to make it third time lucky. Soft Landing went close on her C&D debut a fortnight ago and is second pick ahead of Oli Rix's new recruit Mr Keble.

  1. BELLA ANGELINA
  2. SOFT LANDING
  3. MR KEBLE

races.name: Hotel & Conferencing At Wolverhampton Racecourse EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MUHANDES remains capable of better and is narrowly preferred to Al Widyan, who had an excuse at Newbury last time and went close on all-weather at Kempton prior to that. Sea Palace may prove best of the rest.

  1. MUHANDES (IRE)
  2. AL WIDYAN
  3. SEA PALACE

races.name: Stay At The Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
ZACHARY HICKES rather stands out as an unexposed sort in this line-up, particularly at this trip, and is taken to build on his good third at Yarmouth last month. Oisin Murphy's mount Scarlet Moon is 3-3 on all-weather and is feared most ahead of Percy Jones.

  1. ZACHARY HICKES
  2. SCARLET MOON
  3. PERCY JONES

races.name: Cavani Champion Style Handicap
races.verdict:
A tight-knit handicap in which marginal preference is for C&D scorer NEPTUNE LEGEND who has slipped in the weights and now has the services of Billy Loughnane. Far Too Fizzy could emerge as the chief threat with Oisin Murphy also an eye-catching booking, while On Key and Koffee And Kale can also have a say.

  1. NEPTUNE LEGEND (IRE)
  2. FAR TOO FIZZY
  3. ON KEY

races.name: Race & Rest - Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Handicap
races.verdict:
SNAAFY rates the clear pick of the weights off the same mark as when a resurgent third at Leicester a week ago so looks the way to go here. Coxy's Star is next on the list on the back of her recent C&D second, while Aurelune and Gifts Differing also need factoring in.

  1. SNAAFY
  2. COXY'S STAR
  3. AURELUNE (IRE)

races.name: Cavani Raceday Style Handicap
races.verdict:
MIDNIGHT MEDIA rates the pick of the weights and is fancied to gain a third success of the season. Currumbin seems sure to go well too but could have to settle for runner-up spot once more ahead of Pipily and Bradbury.

  1. MIDNIGHT MEDIA
  2. CURRUMBIN (IRE)
  3. PIPILY

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Nursery
races.verdict:
It could be worth chancing NOTIMETOTAKEOFF, who looks on a decent mark for his nursery bow and has the assistance of Rossa Ryan. King of Persia and Golden Oasis are feared most.

  1. NOTIMETOTAKEOFF (IRE)
  2. KING OF PERSIA
  3. GOLDEN OASIS

races.name: British EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
ROMOTOSO was a disappointing favourite at Southwell last time but a return to turf and a longer trip can see her in a better light. She gets the nod. Tradittion and Lady Foxtrot can also make their presence felt.

  1. ROMOTOSO
  2. TRADITTION
  3. LADY FOXTROT (IRE)

races.name: British EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
This can go to WEDYAN, who should have learnt plenty from her encouraging Pontefract debut last month. Pivotal Voyage and Hoya Bella are also potential improvers and are feared most.

  1. WEDYAN (IRE)
  2. PIVOTAL VOYAGE (IRE)
  3. HOYA BELLA

races.name: British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
NEW YEAR'S EVE has an appealing pedigree and will have learnt plenty from last month's Haydock debut. She is taken to get off the mark. Comrade Alexi looks the chief threat on form, whilst newcomers Velora and Lady Phillips are both much respected.

  1. NEW YEAR'S EVE
  2. COMRADE ALEXI (IRE)
  3. VELORA (IRE)

races.name: Join Racing TV Now Handicap
races.verdict:
This is wide open. DASHING DICK rates just the pick of the weights on the back of a resurgent second here so edges the vote from Tiriac who hinted at a revival with a recent Nottingham fourth and rates a big threat. Irish Nectar, That's Random and Bay Breeze can all play a prominent role too in this highly competitive sprint.

  1. DASHING DICK (IRE)
  2. TIRIAC
  3. IRISH NECTAR

races.name: Christmas Parties At Leicester Racecourse Book Now Handicap
races.verdict:
A few with chances but LAW OF DESIGN is fancied to build on recent promise and gain an overdue success off a handy-looking mark. Oviedo arrives in fine form and heads the list of dangers with Cypriot Diaspora and Francesi also in the mix.

  1. LAW OF DESIGN (IRE)
  2. OVIEDO (IRE)
  3. CYPRIOT DIASPORA

races.name: Happy 80th Reg Ling Handicap
races.verdict:
ENGLISH TIME impressively landed a maiden at Ffos Las (form been franked) when last seen out in June and is fancied to return in style off a lenient-looking mark for his handicap debut. Flight Control is feared most on the back of a very good Doncaster second, while Kodi Lion, Ata Rangi and Sergeant Wilko can all play a prominent role too.

  1. ENGLISH TIME (IRE)
  2. FLIGHT CONTROL (IRE)
  3. KODI LION (IRE)

races.name: racingtv.com Handicap
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for any number of these, but preference is for NEW OBJECTIVE, who has improved for the step up in trip and Kevin & Lauren Frost's 3-y-o can supplement his recent Newcastle success from 4 lb higher. Ataturk failed to land the odds at Chepstow back in the summer but remaining with potential granted a truer test, he heads up the dangers. We've Got This, Ricardo Phillips and Fizzy Bear are just a handful of others to consider, too.

  1. NEW OBJECTIVE
  2. ATATURK
  3. WE'VE GOT THIS (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series 3-Y-O Hurdle
races.verdict:
DANNY POWER looked a good prospect when making an impressive start at Listowel last month and can defy a penalty before having his sights raised. Contador is an interesting recruit from France for Gordon Elliott and could be the danger, ahead of Sea of Dubka, who took to hurdling well at Killarney for all she was a fortunate winner.

  1. DANNY POWER (IRE)
  2. CONTADOR
  3. SEA OF DUBKA (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
ZUZUKEL went mightily close to opening his account here last season so Tony Martin's 6-y-o gets the tentative vote to go one better on return over Pavilion End, who has been in good order on the level and looks a potential improver now sent down the handicap route. Chantilly Wings and Houndsworth can fight out minor honours.

  1. ZUZUKEL (FR)
  2. PAVILION END
  3. CHANTILLY WINGS (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Hurdle
races.verdict:
The return to around 3m should suit SAMUI who may prove the answer to this trappy contest. Sandor Clegane isn't the easiest to win with but is still classy and has a decent record fresh so he might be the one to give Gordon Elliott's charge most to do.

  1. SAMUI
  2. SANDOR CLEGANE (IRE)
  3. BUDDY ONE (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
LIVE TO LAUGH's reappearance third at Listowel suggests he should have a race in him from his lower hurdle mark, particularly as the form has been franked by the fourth winning since. Warmer Days Ahead has had the form of his latest Kilbeggan success boosted on a few occasions and is second choice. Milan Forth and Labondance complete the shortlist.

  1. LIVE TO LAUGH (IRE)
  2. WARMER DAYS AHEAD (FR)
  3. MILAN FORTH (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
EALU TAPA upped his game when fourth at Navan last month and that form looks strong. With this longer trip likely to suit, he makes plenty of appeal. The Rebel Fox and Doctor Elvis rate the principal dangers.

  1. EALU TAPA (IRE)
  2. THE REBEL FOX (IRE)
  3. DOCTOR ELVIS (FR)

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
POETIC FOCUS was only narrowly denied in a similar race at Clonmel earlier this month and remains feasibly treated. She can go one better here. Granlahan and Another Challenge head the list of dangers.

  1. POETIC FOCUS (IRE)
  2. GRANLAHAN (IRE)
  3. ANOTHER CHALLENGE (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
LAS BRISAS BOY did too much too soon over 3m at Fairyhouse last Monday and is taken to come good back over shorter. No Big Deal was back on form when fourth at Gowran recently and heads the dangers along with G N Jefferson and Soldier Saint, who represents last year's winning yard.

  1. LAS BRISAS BOY (IRE)
  2. NO BIG DEAL (IRE)
  3. G N JEFFERSON

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Flat Race
races.verdict:
JUNCTION ROAD has been the subject of a notable stable switch since her promising debut at Down Royal 7 weeks ago and she could make a winning start for Henry de Bromhead if building on that. Shuil Solas and Back In Favour are a couple of others who seem sure to be in the mix. Eastern Whisper is the most interesting newcomer.

  1. JUNCTION ROAD (IRE)
  2. SHUIL SOLAS (IRE)
  3. BACK IN FAVOUR (IRE)
